North West.description: Nigeria's main grain belt. Highest Maize, Sorghum, Sesame, Wheat production.

North Central.description: Middle Belt. Ginger heartland (Plateau), Cashew/Cocoa belt (Kogi).

North East.description: Semi-arid. Sorghum, Maize. Conflict premium on imports in Borno.

South West.description: Commercial capital. Lagos is the price-setter for consumer markets.

South East.description: High consumption, low production of traded commodities. Import-dependent.

South South.description: Oil belt. High purchasing power. Cocoa producer (Delta).
